_comment: AC02 tier-1 phrases. DATA, not code — a different deployment brings its
own vocabulary and nothing in Application/backend/ changes.
These match only a WHOLE short utterance, after normalisation (lowercased,
punctuation and Arabic diacritics stripped, alef/yaa/taa-marbuta folded).
So 'مرحبا' is a greeting and 'مرحبا، ما ميزانية المشروع؟' is not — it is a
question with a greeting attached, and must reach retrieval.
Add a phrase here only when it is unambiguous on its own. Anything that
could plausibly begin a real question belongs in tier 2, where the
